title: THEY WANT 07 OFF THE LIST
body: The order came in writing today. 07 comes off the peer list before the announcement. Off the list. I asked if that meant off the air and got no reply, so I drove up there, took it off the list, and left everything else exactly as I found it.
It wasn't Marek, before anyone starts. You know who has to sign these.
I don't know why you'd announce a discovery and cut off the station that made it. I'm a sysop. Nobody tells me.
